answer.reason: The verses tell two events of Abihu: going up the mountain and seeing God, and dying for offering strange fire.

clauses.english: went up with Moses and saw the God of Israel
clauses.quote: And they saw the God of Israel

clauses.english: offered strange fire before the LORD and was devoured by fire from the LORD
clauses.quote: there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD
